verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community report that WezTerm lacks iTerm2's quake-style hotkey visor mode. The suggested fixes are a GitHub-issue workaround and Hammerspoon on macOS, which are user-side or host-platform tools, not a WezTerm capability. No first-party documentation shows a global summon hotkey or dropdown window.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can summon the terminal instantly with a global hotkey or quake-style dropdown window
